title: Final State Expressions
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the states |j, m> for m = l - 1/2 and m = l + 1/2 in terms of |l, m_l; s, m_s>.

title: Use of Angular Momentum Coupling
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of angular momentum coupling and the relationship between j and l.

title: Normalization Conditions
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly apply normalization conditions for the coefficients a and b in the state expressions.

title: Correct Application of Operators
description: Important Criteria: The student should accurately apply the lowering operator J_- and its effects on the states.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as incorrect signs or missing factors in the final expressions.
